title: anabasis syriaca var. zoharyi
intro: Anabasis syriaca var. zoharyi, commonly known as Desert Lasios, is a plant species in the Chenopodiaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Desert Lasios are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are believed to help alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Anabasis syriaca var. zoharyi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
